basic_info.description: Nestled on the pristine east side slope of Russian Hill, this beautifully appointed two bedroom, one-and-a-half bathroom condominium blends classic character with modern updates. Located in a boutique three-unit building,this home is an inviting retreat in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. Refinished hardwood floors, elegant period details, and marble bathrooms create a timeless aesthetic throughout the home.South-facing with double-pane windows, the unit is filled with natural light, offering warmth and a welcoming ambiance. A gas fireplace in the living room provides a cozy touch, while the updated kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances and expansive views of the Bay. Enjoy unobstructed views of the Bay and Alcatraz from the primary bedroom. Includes in-unit washer/dryer, deeded garage parking for one car, a private storage unit, and access to a shared garden for tranquil outdoor moments. Step outside to stunning views of Coit Tower and enjoy nearby parks, coffee shops, and some of San Francisco's finest restaurants.This exceptional home offers the perfect balance of historic charm and modern living in a premier San Francisco neighborhood. Don't miss your chance to experience life on Russian Hill.
